prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Save Your New Desktop Pet", "Create or log into your account now so your custom pet profile and progress stay safe across restarts."]
1: ["Meet Your Companion", "Your pet is ready for your desktop! Take a quick 10-second tour of basic controls.", "Quick Desktop Controls", "Learn how to summon, move, and talk to your pet right from your desktop edge or tray.", "Start Playing"]
2: ["Choose Your Perfect Desktop Pet", "Select a companion style to bring to life on your desktop screen.", "Select Companion Style"]
3: ["Upload Reference Photos", "Provide clear photos of your real pet so our generator can render a matching 3D desktop pet.", "Preview Pet Render", "Review the generated 3D render before finalizing your adoption certificate details.", "Looks Great"]
4: ["Preparing Desktop Pet Assets", "We are generating custom animations and overlay scripts for your companion screen.", "Desktop Pet Tips"]
5: ["If your pet disappears, check your system tray or press Ctrl+Shift+P to reveal it instantly.", "Shortcut: Ctrl+Shift+P to Summon"]
6: ["Pick Your Companion Journey", "Choose instant pre-built companions or upload custom photos to design your pet.", "Instant 1-Click Pet Available"]
7: ["Generating Companion...", "Rendering custom pet assets can take a minute. Enable alerts to get notified when ready.", "Notify Me When Ready"]
8: ["Sign In to Protect Your Pet Profile", "Linking your account ensures your pet custom settings and accessories are saved safely to the cloud.", "Use your main sign-in method to avoid accidental pet profile resets."]
9: ["Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "Name your companion and confirm registration to place them onto your desktop.", "Official Stamp Animation"]
